title: JavaScript Certification Test (2.3 to 2.5)
instructions: You have only one attempt. Read each scenario carefully before selecting the best answer.

questions.text: A developer is designing an application to manage car data where each car must store properties such as brand, model, and year, along with a function to start the engine. Which JavaScript structure is most suitable to represent this real-world entity efficiently?

A developer accesses object properties using both car.brand and car['brand'] in different parts of the code. What is the primary reason for using bracket notation instead of dot notation in some scenarios?
An application dynamically adds a property email to a user object using a variable key. Which approach correctly achieves this behavior?
A developer wants to verify whether a specific property exists in an object before accessing it. Which operator provides a direct boolean result for this check?
A developer removes a property color from an object to clean up unused data. Which keyword is used to perform this operation?
A method inside an object tries to access another property using this.name. What does the this keyword refer to in this context?
A developer creates an object using new Object() and later assigns properties individually. What is this approach called?
A program stores a function inside an object property and calls it using object.method(). What is this function called?
A developer defines a method fullName that returns firstName plus lastName. What is the main advantage of using a method instead of storing full name directly?
A system logs current date and time using new Date(). What does this constructor return when called without arguments?
A developer uses getMonth() and expects January to return 1, but receives 0 instead. What is the reason for this behavior?
A system calculates a future date by adding 7 days to today using setDate(). What concept is being applied?
A developer subtracts two Date objects and gets a large numeric value. What does this value represent?
An application displays date in user-friendly format using toLocaleDateString(). What is the main benefit of this method?
A countdown timer divides milliseconds by 1000*60*60*24. What is this calculation primarily used for?
A developer uses Math.round(4.6) while processing user ratings. What will be the output?
A billing system ensures all negative values become positive before calculations. Which method is most suitable?
A developer wants to remove decimal part without rounding while processing numeric input. Which method is correct?
A developer generates random numbers between 1 and 10 using Math.random(). What additional operation is required?
A developer needs the largest number from a set of values. Which method directly provides this?
A function add(a,b) returns a + b. What is the purpose of the return keyword in this context?
A developer calls a function before defining it and it works successfully. What concept allows this behavior?
A function expression is assigned to a variable and called later. Why might this approach be preferred?
An arrow function is written in one line without curly braces. What happens automatically?
A variable declared inside a function cannot be accessed outside. What concept does this demonstrate?
A primitive value passed into a function remains unchanged after function execution. What concept explains this behavior?
An object passed into a function gets modified internally. What does this demonstrate?
A developer creates a function without a name and passes it into setTimeout. What type of function is this?
A function is passed as an argument to another function and executed later. What is this pattern called?
A developer extracts part of a string using substr(2,4). What does this return?
A developer mistakenly assumes substr(2,4) ends at index 4. What is the correct behavior?
A developer defines a method inside an object that increments age using this.age++. What is the effect of calling this method?
A developer formats currency using num.toFixed(2). What does this method ensure?
A developer creates a user object and later wants to access a property whose name is stored inside a variable fieldName. Which approach ensures correct access to that property?
An application stores multiple related values such as name, age, and city together. The developer chooses an object instead of separate variables. What is the primary advantage of this design choice?
A developer tries to access a property that does not exist in an object. What will JavaScript return in this scenario?
A developer wants to loop through object properties but has not yet learned loops. Instead, they manually access properties using dot notation. What is the main limitation of this approach?
A developer uses new Date(2000, 0, 1) expecting February but gets January. What is the reason for this unexpected result?
A system displays time using toLocaleTimeString() every second. What type of data does this method return?
A developer calculates remaining time for an event by subtracting two Date objects. Which data type is returned from this subtraction?
A developer wants to ensure a number always rounds up regardless of decimal value. Which method should be used?
A developer wants to always round down a decimal number during price calculations. Which method is most suitable?
A developer needs to determine whether a number is positive, negative, or zero. Which method directly provides this information?
A developer uses Math.pow(2,3) in a calculation. What does this expression represent?
A developer needs to calculate the square root of a number entered by a user. Which method should be used?
A developer generates a random number using Math.random() and multiplies it by 10. Why is Math.floor() often applied afterward?
A function greet(name = 'Guest') is defined. What happens if the function is called without passing any argument?
A developer defines a function but forgets to call it. What will happen?
A developer assigns a function to a variable and calls it later. What type of function is this?
A developer uses an arrow function for a short calculation. What is a key difference compared to traditional functions?
A developer accesses a global variable inside a function successfully. Why is this allowed?
A developer defines a variable inside a function and tries to access it outside, resulting in an error. What is the cause?
A developer modifies an object inside a function and sees the change reflected outside. Why does this occur?
A developer passes a number into a function and modifies it inside, but original value remains unchanged. Why?
A developer creates a utility function to format currency using toFixed(2). What type of value does this method return?
A developer wants to ensure a number displays exactly two decimal places even if unnecessary zeros are added. Which method is appropriate?
A developer uses split(), reverse(), and join() together on a string. What is the main purpose of this combination?
A developer creates a function that returns multiple values such as area and perimeter inside an object. What is this pattern called?
A developer writes a function that accepts parameters but forgets to return a value. What will be returned by default?
A developer calls a function with fewer arguments than parameters defined. What happens to missing parameters?
A developer builds a reusable utility library with multiple helper functions. What is the main benefit of this approach?
